_about: Titan overlay, deep-merged over data/events.json. Solar flares and moonquakes stay on the Moon (null removes them). Types: rules/types.ts EventsFile, rules/titanTypes.ts RainstormSpec.

rainstorm._placeholder: Rules (T3), placeholders. One methane rainstorm per mission: a random start in 240 to 600 s (late day to deep night), forecast 60 s ahead by the lander's weather station, 60 s long, building up and dying down over 10 s (rules/storm.ts scheduleRainstorm, stormIntensity). At full strength the base freeze rate is x freezeFactor (+0.18/s), so every rover cools faster; photos do not count from start to end. Visibility is the renderer's (look.fog with scene.setStorm(intensity)), so there is no visibility factor.
rainstorm.source: Cassini saw a large equatorial cloud system in late 2010, and over 500,000 km2 of ground darkened afterward, most likely from methane rain (Turtle et al. 2011, Science 331:1414).
